name: Lemon Dessert
subtitle: From Grandma Maureen
equipment: Ungreased pan smaller than 9×11, or ramekins; larger pan for water

steps.title: Mix the dry base
steps.body: In a bowl, combine: **1 cup sugar**, **¼ cup flour**, dash salt and **2 Tbsp melted butter**.

steps.title: Add lemon
steps.body: Add: **2 tsp grated lemon rind** and **⅓ cup lemon juice**.

steps.title: Mix the milk and yolks
steps.body: In another bowl, slowly stir together: **1½ cups milk, scalded** and **3 beaten egg yolks**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Add this mixture to first bowl, then fold in: **3 stiff beaten egg whites**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour into an ungreased pan (smaller than 9×11), or ramekins. Place this pan in a larger pan of water. Bake at 325°F for about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve warm with a dollop of ice cream.
